title: Referral Timeliness Factors for Detour Delays, Wayfare Rides
content:
The referral timeliness factor of a detour delay referral on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** counts the calendar days from the charge date of the trip's fare charge to today.

**Scale.** At least the late referral days of 21 take the late referral timeliness factor of 0.7; at least the mid referral days of 8 but fewer than 21 take the mid referral timeliness factor of 0.9; fewer than 8 days are not reduced.

| Days from the fare charge date to today | Referral timeliness factor |
|---|---|
| fewer than 8 | not reduced |
| at least 8, fewer than 21 | 0.9 |
| 21 or more | 0.7 |

## Either side of each line (hypothetical; fare charged on 20 November)

- 27 November is day 7: not reduced. 28 November is day 8: 0.9.
- 10 December is day 20: 0.9. 11 December is day 21: 0.7.
